decisions.reason: The same message extends the clean-editing rule to monthly production without withdrawing its trial applicability; the existing Event incorrectly replaces the prior trial context.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
hy brother

Big update — you now have access to B-roll footage to take your clips to the next level.

B-roll link: <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lPMIpcCWSCVVjehwoijwEuSb7mu-BmQO>

Here is what I need from you:

Create **5 perfect clips** using this B-roll footage alongside Teyron's long-form YouTube videos.

Every clip must follow these rules exactly:
\- 45 to 60 seconds minimum
\- Captures a complete moment — full lesson or story from start to finish
\- B-roll used naturally to support the message — not randomly placed
\- White text only — no colored fonts, no effects on text
\- Clean simple editing — no heavy animations, no flashy transitions
\- Background music at low volume — never louder than Teyron's voice
\- Standalone — someone who has never seen Teyron before watches it and understands it completely

**DEADLINE: Thursday.** I need to review and approve every clip before they go live Friday. That means I need them in my hands by Thursday morning — not Thursday night. If I do not have them by then they do not get posted this week.

Move fast. The B-roll is there to make the message more powerful — use it where it adds to the moment, not just to fill space.

Send your 5 clips as a Google Drive folder link with your name as the folder title. Set it to anyone with the link can view.

These are the first real clips going live. Make them perfect.

Cleavon

decisions.reason: The source moments remain Teyron's long-form YouTube videos; the B-roll is supplemental footage and the caption-style scope change does not alter source selection.
The candidate already requires 45–60-second clips in monthly production, so the message only restates its current state.
The candidate already applies to monthly production, and its existing same-message MODIFY captures the newly stated audience-comprehension criterion.
The message requires a complete standalone lesson or story but does not modify the separate standard for selecting strong or impactful source moments.
Personal approval before publication is already required; the Thursday/Friday language is a batch deadline rather than a change to the approval gate.
A task to create five launch clips does not change or resume the deferred quota of 100 approved clips per month.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the Google Drive folder, folder-title, access, and monthly-review workflow changes.
The clip-production and caption instructions do not change Lead Clipper assignment, training, or responsibilities.
The five clips are described as the first real clips going live, not as a new qualification trial or change to the existing qualification method.
The message preserves the existing rule that approved clips are published; Friday is a one-batch schedule and does not change the persistent publishing destination or eligibility state.
